questions.text:
निम्नलिखित घटनाओं को कालक्रमानुसार व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
I. फ्रांस की क्रांति
II. नेपोलियन का इटली पर हमला
III. इटली का एकीकरण
IV. वियना शांति संधि
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following incidents in chronological order and choose the correct option.
I. French Revolution
II. Napoleon's invasion of Italy
III. Unification of Italy
IV. Vienna Peace Treaty
questions.solution: The correct chronological order starts with the French Revolution in 1789. This was followed by Napoleon's invasion of Italy in 1797. The Vienna Peace Treaty was signed later in 1815 after Napoleon's defeat, and the Unification of Italy was a much later process completing in 1870. Therefore, the sequence I, II, IV, III is accurate.
questions.solution_hindi: सही कालानुक्रमिक क्रम 1789 में फ्रांसीसी क्रांति से शुरू होता है। इसके बाद 1797 में नेपोलियन का इटली पर आक्रमण हुआ। वियना शांति संधि पर 1815 में नेपोलियन की हार के बाद हस्ताक्षर किए गए थे, और इटली का एकीकरण 1870 में पूरा होने वाली बहुत बाद की प्रक्रिया थी। इसलिए, अनुक्रम I, II, IV, III सटीक है।
questions.chapter: The Rise of Nationalism in Europe

questions.text:
रिक्त स्थान की पूर्ति के लिए सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
'रेशम मार्ग' (सिल्क रूट) से भारत व दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया के _______ दुनिया के दूसरे भागों में पहुँचते थे ।
questions.text_english:
Choose the correct option to fill in the blank.
_______ from India and Southeast Asia travelled through 'Silk Route' to other parts of the world.
questions.solution: The Silk Route was historically famous for facilitating the trade of fine textiles and valuable spices from India and Southeast Asia to Europe and other regions. While precious metals flowed from Europe to Asia to pay for these goods, it was clothes and spices that primarily travelled outwards from India.
questions.solution_hindi: सिल्क रूट ऐतिहासिक रूप से भारत और दक्षिण-पूर्व एशिया से यूरोप और अन्य क्षेत्रों में महीन वस्त्रों और मूल्यवान मसालों के व्यापार को सुविधाजनक बनाने के लिए प्रसिद्ध था।
questions.chapter: The Making of a Global World

questions.text: काँग्रेस के भीतर 'स्वराज पार्टी' के संस्थापकों से संबंधित सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Choose the correct option, related to the founders of the 'Swaraj Party' within the Congress.

options.A: सुभाष चंद्र बोस व जवाहरलाल नेहरू

options_english.A: Subhas Chandra Bose and Jawaharlal Nehru

questions.solution: The Swaraj Party was formed within the Congress by C.R. Das and Motilal Nehru in 1922. They advocated for a return to council politics to oppose British policies from within the legislative councils, differing from the views of younger leaders like Subhas Chandra Bose and Jawaharlal Nehru who pressed for more radical mass agitation.
questions.solution_hindi: स्वराज पार्टी का गठन 1922 में सी.आर. दास और मोतीलाल नेहरू द्वारा कांग्रेस के भीतर किया गया था।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किसने कहा कि - मुद्रण ईश्वर की दी हुई महानतम देन है, सबसे बड़ा तोहफ़ा । ?
questions.text_english: Who among the following said - Printing is the ultimate gift of God and the greatest one.?
questions.solution: Martin Luther, the famous religious reformer, uttered these words in praise of the printing press. He realized that printing played a major role in spreading his translation of the New Testament and his Protestant ideas, effectively bypassing the Catholic Church's control over information.
questions.solution_hindi: प्रसिद्ध धार्मिक सुधारक मार्टिन लूथर ने प्रिंटिंग प्रेस की प्रशंसा में ये शब्द कहे थे।
questions.chapter: Print Culture and the Modern World
questions.topic: The Print Revolution and Its Impact

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
अभिकथन (A) : हिमालय में प्रसिद्ध 'चिपको आंदोलन' कई क्षेत्रों में वन कटाई रोकने में कामयाब रहा ।
कारण (R) : इसके द्वारा स्थानीय पौधों की जातियों का प्रयोग करके सामुदायिक वनीकरण अभियान को सफल बनाया गया ।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A) : The famous 'Chipko Movement' in the Himalayas successfully resisted deforestation in several areas.
Reason (R) : Through this, community afforestation campaign with indigenous species was made enormously successful.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है ।
options.B: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: Both the assertion and the reason represent true facts regarding the achievements of the Chipko Movement. It successfully prevented mass logging and also promoted community afforestation using indigenous plants. However, the reason provided (afforestation) is an additional achievement and not the direct explanatory cause of how they resisted deforestation (which was done by hugging trees). Thus, both are true, but R does not explain A.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन और कारण दोनों चिपको आंदोलन की उपलब्धियों के बारे में सत्य तथ्य प्रस्तुत करते हैं। हालांकि, प्रदान किया गया कारण वनों की कटाई का प्रत्यक्ष स्पष्टीकरण नहीं है।
questions.topic: Conservation of Forest and Wildlife in India

questions.text:
स्तंभ I का मिलान स्तंभ II से कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
स्तंभ I (बाँध)      स्तंभ II (नदी)
i. सरदार सरोवर      a. सतलुज
ii. हीराकुड         b. कृष्णा
iii. भाखड़ा नांगल     c. नर्मदा
iv. नागार्जुन सागर     d. महानदी
questions.text_english:
Match Column I with Column II and choose the correct option.
Column I (Dams)      Column II (Rivers)
i. Sardar Sarovar      a. Sutlej
ii. Hirakud         b. Krishna
iii. Bhakra Nangal     c. Narmada
iv. Nagarjuna Sagar     d. Mahanadi
questions.solution: The correct pairings of dams to their respective rivers are: Sardar Sarovar is built across the Narmada river (i-c). Hirakud is built across the Mahanadi river (ii-d). The Bhakra Nangal project is located on the Sutlej river (iii-a). The Nagarjuna Sagar dam is built on the Krishna river (iv-b). This corresponds to option D.
questions.solution_hindi: सही मिलान है: सरदार सरोवर नर्मदा नदी पर (i-c), हीराकुड महानदी पर (ii-d), भाखड़ा नांगल सतलुज पर (iii-a) और नागार्जुन सागर कृष्णा नदी पर (iv-b)। यह विकल्प D से मेल खाता है।
questions.topic: Multi-purpose River Projects and Integrated Water Resources Management

questions.text: भारत में 'मैंगनीज़' के उत्पादन में निम्नलिखित राज्यों के अंश (प्रतिशत में) के लिए अधिकतम से न्यूनतम क्रम वाले सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Choose the correct option for the following States' share (in percentage) in the production of 'manganese' in India from the highest to the lowest order.
questions.solution: According to the resource distribution data in the NCERT text, Madhya Pradesh is the leading producer of manganese in India, commanding the highest share. It is closely followed by Maharashtra, and then Odisha, with Karnataka holding a smaller percentage. The correct descending sequence is Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Odisha, Karnataka.
questions.solution_hindi: आंकड़ों के अनुसार, मध्य प्रदेश भारत में मैंगनीज का प्रमुख उत्पादक है। इसके बाद महाराष्ट्र, ओडिशा और कर्नाटक का स्थान है। सही अवरोही क्रम मध्य प्रदेश, महाराष्ट्र, ओडिशा, कर्नाटक है।

questions.text:
सत्ता के बँटवारे के पक्ष में दिए गए तर्कों को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
I. पक्षपात की संभावना को कम करता है ।
II. निर्णय लेने की प्रक्रिया को अवरुद्ध करता है ।
III. विविधताओं में सामंजस्य स्थापित करता है ।
IV. सत्ता में लोगों की भागीदारी को बढ़ाता है।
questions.text_english:
Read the arguments given in the favour of power sharing and choose the correct option.
I. Reduces the likelihood of bias.
II. Barricades the decision-making process.
III. Accommodates diversities.
IV. Increases the participation of people in power.

options.A: केवल I, II व III सही हैं ।
options.B: केवल II, III व IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल I, III व IV सही हैं।
options.D: केवल I, II व IV सही हैं।

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct.
options_english.B: Only II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only I, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: Only I, II and IV are correct.

questions.solution: Power sharing is beneficial because it reduces conflict and bias (I), successfully accommodates social diversities (III), and ensures citizens have a stake in the system, thereby increasing participation (IV). Statement II is incorrect because barricading or delaying decision-making is typically seen as a negative consequence of power-sharing rather than an argument in its favour.
questions.solution_hindi: सत्ता की साझेदारी फायदेमंद है क्योंकि यह पूर्वाग्रह को कम करती है (I), विविधताओं में सामंजस्य स्थापित करती है (III), और लोगों की भागीदारी को बढ़ाती है (IV)। कथन II गलत है क्योंकि निर्णय लेने में बाधा डालना पक्ष में तर्क नहीं है।

questions.text: भारतीय संविधान में वर्णित 'शिक्षा' निम्नलिखित में से किस सूची के अंतर्गत आती है ?
questions.text_english: 'Education' falls under which one of the following lists given in the Indian Constitution?
questions.solution: In the Indian Constitution, subjects that are of common interest to both the Union Government and the State Governments are included in the Concurrent List. Education is one such subject, meaning both the central and state governments can legislate on it. Hence, it belongs to the Concurrent List.
questions.solution_hindi: भारतीय संविधान में शिक्षा समवर्ती सूची के अंतर्गत आती है, जिसका अर्थ है कि केंद्र और राज्य दोनों सरकारें इस पर कानून बना सकती हैं।
questions.topic: What makes India a federal country?

questions.text: 1992 में भारत में संविधान संशोधन करके निम्नलिखित में से किस संस्था में महिलाओं के लिए आरक्षण की व्यवस्था की गई ?
questions.text_english: In which one of the following institutions in India was a system of reservation for women made by amending the Constitution in 1992?
questions.solution: The 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendment Acts of 1992 established the system of local self-government (Panchayats and Municipalities) in India. A major feature of these amendments was the reservation of one-third of all seats for women in these local governance bodies to ensure gender representation at the grassroots level.
questions.solution_hindi: 1992 के 73वें और 74वें संविधान संशोधन के माध्यम से पंचायतों और नगर पालिकाओं (स्थानीय स्वशासन) में महिलाओं के लिए एक-तिहाई सीटों के आरक्षण की व्यवस्था की गई।

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
अभिकथन (A) : आधुनिक लोकतंत्र राजनीतिक दलों के बिना नहीं चल सकता है ।
कारण (R) : निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधि केवल अपने-अपने निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों के प्रति जवाबदेह होंगे, देश के प्रति नहीं ।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A): Modern democracy cannot function without political parties.
Reason (R) : Elected representatives will be accountable only to their constituencies, not towards the country.

options.C: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.D: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है ।

options_english.C: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.D: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: The assertion is true because political parties provide an organized mechanism to form a responsible government. The reason correctly explains this: if there were no parties, every elected representative would be independent. They would only be accountable for their local constituency, and no one would be responsible for making large-scale national policies. Thus, R correctly explains A.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन सत्य है क्योंकि राजनीतिक दल जिम्मेदार सरकार बनाने का तंत्र प्रदान करते हैं। कारण सही ढंग से बताता है कि यदि दल नहीं होते, तो निर्दलीय प्रतिनिधि केवल अपने निर्वाचन क्षेत्र के लिए जवाबदेह होते। अतः R, A की सही व्याख्या है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित देशों में से किसमें द्विदलीय व्यवस्था है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following countries has a two-party system?
questions.solution: A two-party system is a political framework where two major political parties dominate the government landscape. The United States of America is a classic example of this system, where the political sphere is heavily dominated by the Democrats and the Republicans. Conversely, China has a one-party system.
questions.solution_hindi: संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में द्विदलीय व्यवस्था है, जहाँ मुख्य रूप से दो प्रमुख दल (डेमोक्रेट और रिपब्लिकन) सत्ता के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करते हैं।
questions.topic: How many parties should we have?

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्र में महिलाओं का अपनी राष्ट्रीय संसदों (2018) में प्रतिनिधित्व सबसे अधिक था ?
questions.text_english: In which of the following regions was women representation the highest in their respective National Parliaments (2018)?
questions.solution: Global averages of women in national parliaments show considerable regional disparities. According to data around 2018, the Nordic countries stand out globally with the highest proportion of women representation in their national legislatures, reflecting their deeply rooted gender equality policies.
questions.solution_hindi: नॉर्डिक देशों में 2018 के आंकड़ों के अनुसार अपनी राष्ट्रीय संसदों में महिलाओं का प्रतिनिधित्व विश्व स्तर पर सबसे अधिक था।

questions.text:
लोकतंत्र की निम्नलिखित विशेषताओं को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
I. स्वतंत्र एवं निष्पक्ष चुनाव
II. कानून के समक्ष समानता
III. व्यक्ति की गरिमा
IV. बहुसंख्यकों का शासन
questions.text_english:
Read the following characteristics of democracy and choose the correct option.
I. Free and fair elections
II. Equality before law
III. Dignity of a person
IV. Majority rule

options.A: केवल I, II व III सही हैं ।
options.B: केवल II, III व IV सही हैं।
options.C: केवल I, III व IV सही हैं ।
options.D: केवल I, II व IV सही हैं ।

options_english.A: Only I, II and III are correct.
options_english.B: Only II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.C: Only I, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: Only I, II and IV are correct.

questions.solution: Democracy is foundationally characterized by free and fair elections, ensuring equality before the law, and upholding the dignity of individuals. While decisions are often taken by majority vote, 'Majority rule' (implying the absolute rule of a dominant community without minority rights) is antithetical to true democratic values. Therefore, I, II, and III are correct.
questions.solution_hindi: लोकतंत्र स्वतंत्र और निष्पक्ष चुनाव, कानून के समक्ष समानता और व्यक्ति की गरिमा की विशेषता है। 'बहुसंख्यकों का शासन' एक आदर्श लोकतांत्रिक विशेषता नहीं है क्योंकि यह अल्पसंख्यकों के अधिकारों को दरकिनार कर सकता है।
questions.topic: How do we assess democracy's outcomes?

questions.text:
ऋण के संबंध में निम्नलिखित परिस्थिति को पढ़िए और ऋण के सकारात्मक प्रभाव की पहचान कीजिए ।
सलीम उत्पादन के लिए कार्यशील पूँजी की ज़रूरत को ऋण के द्वारा पूरा करता है। ऋण उसे उत्पादन के कार्यशील खर्चों तथा उत्पादन को समय पर पूरा करने में मदद करता है ।
questions.text_english:
Read the following situation regarding credit and identify the positive impact of credit.
Salim obtains credit to meet the working capital needs of production. The credit helps him to meet the ongoing expenses and complete production on time.

options.A: सलीम पर ऋण का भार बढ़ जाएगा ।
options.D: सलीम ऋण के दुष्चक्र में फँस सकता है।

options_english.A: The burden of credit will increase on Salim.
options_english.D: Salim may get stuck in a debt trap.

questions.solution: In this positive credit situation, Salim uses the loan effectively to purchase raw materials and complete his production on time. Because he meets his production targets successfully, he will be able to sell his goods, pay off the loan, and ultimately see a rise in his overall earnings. Thus, his income will increase.
questions.solution_hindi: इस स्थिति में, सलीम ऋण का उपयोग उत्पादन को समय पर पूरा करने के लिए करता है। इससे वह अपना माल बेच सकेगा, कर्ज चुका सकेगा और अंततः उसकी कमाई बढ़ जाएगी।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित चित्र का अध्ययन कीजिए । चित्र में होने वाला कार्य अर्थव्यवस्था के निम्नलिखित में से किस क्षेत्रक के अंतर्गत आता है ?

नोट : निम्नलिखित प्रश्न केवल दृष्टिबाधित परीक्षार्थियों के लिए प्रश्न संख्या 16 के स्थान पर है।

questions.text_english:
Study the following picture. The work done in the picture comes under which one of the following sectors of the economy ?

Note: The following question is for the Visually Impaired Candidates only, in lieu of Q. No. 16.
Which one of the following sectors has the maximum share in the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of India?
questions.image_description: A woman working in a clothing shop, interacting with a customer and showing garments on the counter.
questions.solution: The image shows a retail transaction occurring in a clothing store, which is a service activity. Selling goods provides a service to the consumer rather than producing a raw material or manufacturing a good. Therefore, retail trade falls distinctly under the Tertiary sector. For the visually impaired alternative question, the Tertiary sector also has the maximum share in India's GDP.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए ।
अभिकथन (A) : भारत में कोई भी व्यक्ति कानूनी तौर पर रुपये में अदायगी को अस्वीकार नहीं कर सकता है ।
कारण (R) : भारत में रुपये को राज्य सरकारें प्राधिकृत करती हैं।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A) : No individual in India can legally refuse a payment made in rupees.
Reason (R) : In India the rupee is authorized by the State Governments.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है ।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: The assertion is true because the Indian Rupee is the legally accepted medium of exchange nationwide, meaning no one can legally refuse a transaction settled in rupees. The reason, however, is completely false. The rupee is authorized by the Central Government and issued by the Reserve Bank of India, not by individual State Governments. Thus, (A) is true but (R) is false.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन सत्य है क्योंकि भारतीय रुपया कानूनी निविदा है। हालांकि, कारण गलत है क्योंकि भारत में रुपये को राज्य सरकारें नहीं, बल्कि केंद्र सरकार प्राधिकृत करती है और भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक इसे जारी करता है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन 'वैश्वीकरण' के आशय का सही वर्णन करता है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following statements best describes the meaning of 'Globalization'?

options.A: व्यापार पर कर संबंधी अवरोधों को हटाना
options.B: उच्च जीवन स्तर को प्रदान करना
options.C: देशों के बीच तीव्र गति से एकीकरण करना
options.D: विदेशी कंपनियों को आकर्षित करने के लिए विशेष कदम उठाना

options_english.A: Removal of tax barriers on trade
options_english.C: Process of rapid integration between countries
options_english.D: Taking special steps to attract foreign companies

questions.solution: Globalization is fundamentally defined as the process of rapid integration or interconnection between different countries across the world. This process encompasses foreign trade, foreign investment, and the movement of people, leading to a closely knit global economy. Options like removing tax barriers are just tools (liberalization) that facilitate this integration.
questions.solution_hindi: वैश्वीकरण का मुख्य अर्थ विभिन्न देशों के बीच तीव्र एकीकरण या अंतर्संबंध की प्रक्रिया है। यह विदेशी व्यापार और निवेश के माध्यम से होता है।

questions.text_english: On which of the following basis does the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) publish the 'Human Development Report'?

options.B: शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य और प्रति व्यक्ति आय
options.D: सकल घरेलू उत्पाद, प्रौद्योगिकी और नवाचार

options_english.B: Education, Health and Per Capita Income
options_english.D: Gross Domestic Product, Technology and Innovation

questions.solution: The Human Development Report published by the UNDP evaluates and compares countries comprehensively. Instead of looking only at economic figures, it uses a multidimensional approach based on three primary indicators: educational levels of the people, their health status (life expectancy), and per capita income.
questions.solution_hindi: यूएनडीपी द्वारा प्रकाशित मानव विकास रिपोर्ट देशों की तुलना मुख्य रूप से तीन संकेतकों के आधार पर करती है: शिक्षा का स्तर, स्वास्थ्य स्थिति और प्रति व्यक्ति आय।

questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A) : Banks are not ready to lend money to certain borrowers.
Reason (R) : Some people do not have collateral.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है ।
options.B: (A) और (R) উভয় सही हैं, लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है ।

options_english.A: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: Banks operate formally and mitigate lending risks by demanding collateral against loans. The assertion correctly identifies that banks refuse loans to certain individuals. The reason provides the valid explanation for this: poor individuals often lack the necessary collateral (assets to guarantee the loan), preventing formal banks from extending credit to them.
questions.solution_hindi: बैंक ऋण देने से पहले ऋणाधार (collateral) की मांग करते हैं ताकि उनके पैसे सुरक्षित रहें। कई गरीब लोगों के पास ऋणाधार नहीं होता है, यही मुख्य कारण है कि बैंक उन्हें ऋण देने से मना कर देते हैं। अतः दोनों सत्य हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।

questions.text: उन्नीसवीं सदी तक यूरोप में ग़रीबी और भूख का ही साम्राज्य था । इस कथन का विश्लेषण कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Until the nineteenth century, poverty and hunger were common in Europe. Analyse the statement.

key_points: Rapid population growth exceeding employment opportunities
Migration to cities causing overcrowded slums
Stiff competition from cheap machine-made imports ruining small-scale producers
Aristocratic dominance and feudal burdens on peasants leading to extreme poverty

questions.solution: During the early nineteenth century, Europe faced an enormous population boom, but employment generation did not keep pace. People from rural areas migrated to cities, ending up in desperately overcrowded slums. Furthermore, traditional small-scale producers faced crippling competition from cheap, machine-made goods imported from industrialized England. In regions where the aristocracy still dominated, poor peasants struggled heavily under the massive burden of feudal dues and obligations.
questions.solution_hindi: उन्नीसवीं सदी में यूरोप में जनसंख्या में भारी वृद्धि हुई, जिससे रोजगार के अवसर कम पड़ गए। लोग गांवों से शहरों की ओर पलायन करने लगे, जिससे शहर भीड़भाड़ वाली मलिन बस्तियों में बदल गए। साथ ही, इंग्लैंड से सस्ते मशीनी उत्पादों के आयात ने स्थानीय कारीगरों को बर्बाद कर दिया। कुलीन वर्ग के वर्चस्व वाले क्षेत्रों में किसान सामंती करों और दायित्वों के बोझ तले दबे हुए थे, जिससे गरीबी और भुखमरी आम हो गई।

questions.text_english: How is energy a basic requirement for economic development of a country? Explain with examples.

key_points: Essential for all sectors of the economy (agriculture, industry, transport)
Required to operate machinery and factories
Necessary for domestic uses like lighting and cooking

questions.solution: Energy is the absolute foundation of a country's economic development as every sector relies heavily on it. For instance, in agriculture, energy is needed to operate tractors and tube wells for irrigation. In the industrial sector, massive amounts of electricity and coal are essential to run complex machinery and factories. Additionally, energy is crucial for daily domestic consumption, commercial activities, and modern transportation systems.
questions.solution_hindi: ऊर्जा किसी भी देश के आर्थिक विकास की रीढ़ है क्योंकि अर्थव्यवस्था का हर क्षेत्र इस पर निर्भर करता है। उदाहरण के लिए, कृषि में ट्रैक्टर और सिंचाई पंप चलाने के लिए ऊर्जा की आवश्यकता होती है। इसी तरह, औद्योगिक क्षेत्र में कारखानों और मशीनों को चलाने के लिए भारी मात्रा में बिजली और कोयले की आवश्यकता होती है। इसके अलावा, परिवहन और घरेलू जरूरतों के लिए भी यह अपरिहार्य है।

(a) Examine the role of the Constitution in the Federal System of India in two points.
OR

sub_questions.text: (a) भारत की संघात्मक व्यवस्था में संविधान की भूमिका का परीक्षण दो बिन्दुओं में कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) Examine the role of the Constitution in the Federal System of India in two points.

key_points: Clearly demarcates the jurisdiction and powers of different tiers of government via lists
Ensures that fundamental provisions cannot be changed unilaterally by one level of government

sub_questions.solution: The Constitution serves as the supreme law that explicitly guarantees the existence and authority of both central and state governments. It clearly demarcates their legislative powers by distributing subjects across the Union, State, and Concurrent lists. Furthermore, it ensures stability, as any fundamental changes to this power-sharing arrangement require the mutual consent of both the central parliament and state legislatures.

sub_questions.text: (b) भारत की संघात्मक व्यवस्था में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय की भूमिका का परीक्षण दो बिन्दुओं में कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Examine the role of the Supreme Court in the Federal System of India in two points.

key_points: Acts as an umpire or arbitrator in disputes between the Centre and the States
Has the power to interpret the Constitution and safeguard the federal structure

sub_questions.solution: In India's federal system, the Supreme Court acts as a vital, independent umpire. Firstly, it possesses the authority to conclusively interpret the provisions of the Constitution regarding the division of powers. Secondly, if any jurisdictional dispute arises between the Central Government and one or more State Governments, the Supreme Court has the original jurisdiction to hear and resolve the conflict fairly.

questions.text_english: How is technology an important factor of globalisation? Explain with examples.

key_points: Rapid improvements in transportation technology enable faster delivery across long distances
Advancements in information and communication technology (IT, internet) allow instant global communication

questions.solution: Technology has been the primary catalyst driving the rapid pace of globalization. Major advancements in transportation technology, such as the use of standard shipping containers, have drastically reduced costs and enabled massive quantities of goods to travel globally at high speeds. Simultaneously, remarkable developments in Information and Communication Technology (ICT)—including the internet, mobile phones, and satellite communication—allow businesses to coordinate operations and share data instantly across continents.

questions.text_english:
Answer any one of the following:
(a) How did people belonging to different communities, regions or language groups develop a sense of collective belonging in the National Movement? Explain with examples.
OR
(b) Workers had their own understanding of Mahatma Gandhi and the notion of 'Swaraj'. Explain the statement with examples.

sub_questions.text: (a) राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन में विभिन्न समुदायों, क्षेत्रों या भाषाओं से संबद्ध अलग-अलग समूहों ने सामूहिक अपनेपन का भाव कैसे विकसित किया ? उदाहरणों सहित स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) How did people belonging to different communities, regions or language groups develop a sense of collective belonging in the National Movement? Explain with examples.

key_points: Shared experience of united struggles against colonialism
Use of cultural processes like folklore, songs, and prints to unify
Creation of powerful symbols like the image of Bharat Mata and the tricolour flag

sub_questions.solution: The sense of collective belonging among diverse groups grew primarily through their shared and united struggles against colonial oppression. Furthermore, cultural processes played a massive role in building nationalism. The identity of India was visually captured in the revered image of 'Bharat Mata', fostering devotion. Nationalists actively collected and revived traditional Indian folklore and folk songs to instil pride. Additionally, powerful unifying icons like the tricolour flag created a strong shared identity.

key_points: Workers interpreted Swaraj based on their specific local grievances
Plantation workers in Assam thought Swaraj meant the freedom to move freely in and out of the confined spaces
They believed Gandhi Raj would end their forced labor and grant them land in their own villages

sub_questions.solution: Different social groups interpreted Gandhi's message and the concept of 'Swaraj' based on their own specific grievances. For instance, the severely restricted plantation workers in Assam believed that Swaraj meant the right to move freely in and out of the enclosed tea gardens. When they heard of the Non-Cooperation Movement, they defied authorities and headed home, fully believing that 'Gandhi Raj' was coming and that land would be distributed to them in their own villages.

questions.text_english: Describe any three features of cultivation of millets in India.

key_points: Millets (Jowar, Bajra, Ragi) have very high nutritional value, rich in iron, calcium, and roughage
They are hardy crops that can be successfully grown in dry regions with minimal rainfall
They can thrive on relatively poor or marginal soils such as sandy or shallow black soils

questions.solution: Firstly, millets like jowar, bajra, and ragi are known as coarse grains but possess exceptionally high nutritional value, being rich in essential minerals like iron and calcium. Secondly, they are incredibly hardy crops that require very minimal irrigation and can be grown successfully in dry and semi-arid climatic regions. Thirdly, they are adaptable and can flourish even on relatively poor, marginal, sandy, or shallow black soils where other major crops would fail.

questions.text_english: Analyse the role of political parties in shaping public opinion.

key_points: Parties raise and highlight important public issues to catch the attention of the masses
They organize movements, agitations, and campaigns for the resolution of problems faced by people
They have lakhs of members spread across the country who guide and influence the common man's perspective

questions.solution: Political parties are fundamental in shaping robust public opinion. They actively raise and highlight critical social and economic issues, bringing them to the forefront of national debate. Furthermore, parties organize mass movements and agitations to demand the resolution of specific problems faced by the populace. Through their extensive network of lakhs of members and affiliated pressure groups spread across the country, they constantly disseminate their ideology, thereby guiding and significantly influencing the perspective of the common citizen.
questions.solution_hindi: राजनीतिक दल जनमत निर्माण में एक अहम भूमिका निभाते हैं। सबसे पहले, वे महत्वपूर्ण सार्वजनिक और राष्ट्रीय मुद्दों को उठाते हैं और उन पर बहस शुरू करते हैं। दूसरा, वे जनता की समस्याओं के समाधान के लिए जन आंदोलन और अभियान आयोजित करते हैं। तीसरा, देश भर में फैले उनके लाखों कार्यकर्ता और सहयोगी दबाव समूह लगातार जनता के बीच वैचारिक प्रचार करते हैं, जिससे आम आदमी के सोचने का नजरिया प्रभावित और आकारित होता है।

questions.text_english: Federal form of government is in direct contrast to the Unitary form of government. Explain the statement.

key_points: Federalism has two or more distinct levels of government, whereas Unitary has only one level or sub-units are strictly subordinate
In Federalism, state governments have their own constitutionally guaranteed powers
In a Unitary system, the central government can pass direct orders to the state/local governments, which is not possible in Federalism

questions.solution: The statement highlights the core structural difference in power distribution. In a federal system, power is divided between a central authority and its constituent states, resulting in two or more independent tiers of government. The state governments possess constitutionally guaranteed autonomous powers and are not merely subordinate to the centre. In direct contrast, a unitary system concentrates all power in one central government; any sub-national units exist merely as administrative extensions and must strictly obey the direct orders of the centre.
questions.solution_hindi: यह कथन शक्तियों के वितरण में बुनियादी अंतर को स्पष्ट करता है। संघीय शासन व्यवस्था में सत्ता केंद्रीय सरकार और राज्य सरकारों के बीच बँटी होती है, और राज्य सरकारों के पास अपने स्वतंत्र, संवैधानिक अधिकार होते हैं। वे केंद्र के अधीन नहीं होते। इसके विपरीत, एकात्मक व्यवस्था में सत्ता एक ही केंद्रीय सरकार के पास केंद्रित होती है। यदि प्रांतीय इकाइयाँ होती भी हैं, तो वे पूरी तरह से केंद्र के अधीन काम करती हैं और केंद्र उन्हें सीधे आदेश दे सकता है।

questions.text_english: Why could different persons have different notions of a country's development? Explain with examples.

key_points: People come from different socio-economic backgrounds and have vastly different life situations
Individuals seek things that are most important to them and fulfill their specific aspirations
Development for one group might be destructive for another (conflicting goals)

questions.solution: People have completely different notions of development because their socio-economic backgrounds, life situations, and daily struggles differ vastly. Consequently, individuals seek goals that fulfill their most pressing, specific aspirations. For example, a landless rural labourer views development as more days of work and better wages. Conversely, a prosperous farmer desires a high support price for his crops. Furthermore, these goals can often conflict; an industrialist may want massive dams for electricity generation, but this very 'development' displaces indigenous tribal populations, destroying their livelihoods.
questions.solution_hindi: विभिन्न लोगों के विकास के लक्ष्य भिन्न होते हैं क्योंकि उनकी जीवन परिस्थितियाँ और सामाजिक-आर्थिक आवश्यकताएँ अलग-अलग होती हैं। हर व्यक्ति उन चीज़ों की आकांक्षा करता है जो उसके लिए सबसे महत्वपूर्ण हैं। उदाहरण के लिए, एक भूमिहीन मज़दूर के लिए विकास का अर्थ है काम के अधिक दिन और बेहतर मज़दूरी, जबकि एक धनी किसान अपनी फसल के लिए उच्च मूल्य चाहता है। इसके अलावा, एक व्यक्ति का विकास दूसरे के लिए विनाशकारी भी हो सकता है; जैसे उद्योगपतियों के लिए बड़े बाँध बनाना विकास है, लेकिन इससे आदिवासियों का जीवन और ज़मीन छिन जाती है।

Answer any one of the following:
(a) The French Revolution created a sense of collective identity amongst the French people. Explain the statement with suitable arguments.
OR

sub_questions.text: (a) फ्रांसीसी क्रांति ने फ्रांसीसी लोगों में एक सामूहिक पहचान की भावना पैदा की । उपयुक्त तर्कों सहित इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) The French Revolution created a sense of collective identity amongst the French people. Explain the statement with suitable arguments.

key_points: Introduction of ideas of la patrie (fatherland) and le citoyen (citizen) emphasizing equal rights
Adoption of a new French tricolour flag, replacing the former royal standard
Formulation of uniform laws for all citizens within its territory
Abolition of internal custom duties and dues, and adopting a uniform system of weights
Promoting French as the common language of the nation

sub_questions.solution: The French Revolutionaries introduced several measures to forge a deep sense of collective identity. Firstly, they promoted the ideas of 'la patrie' (the fatherland) and 'le citoyen' (the citizen), which emphasized the concept of a united community enjoying equal rights under a single constitution. Secondly, a new French tricolour flag was chosen to replace the traditional royal standard. Thirdly, the Estates General was elected by active citizens and renamed the National Assembly. Fourthly, an integrated, centralized administrative system was put in place to formulate uniform laws for everyone, while internal custom duties were entirely abolished to unify the economy. Finally, regional dialects were discouraged, and French, as spoken in Paris, was promoted as the common national language.

sub_questions.text: (b) यूनान के स्वतंत्रता संग्राम ने पूरे यूरोप में शिक्षित अभिजात वर्ग में राष्ट्रीय भावनाओं का संचार किया । उपयुक्त तर्कों सहित इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) The Greek war of independence mobilised nationalist feelings among the educated elite across Europe. Explain the statement with suitable arguments.

key_points: Greece had been part of the Muslim Ottoman Empire, sparking sympathies among Christian Europe
Nationalist sentiment was fueled by the historical view of Greece as the cradle of European civilization
Exiled Greeks and many West Europeans provided substantial active support
Poets and artists romanticized the struggle, raising funds and fighting in the war (e.g., Lord Byron)
The successful Treaty of Constantinople (1832) proved that an empire could be defeated by a nationalist struggle

sub_questions.solution: The Greek War of Independence profoundly mobilized nationalist feelings across Europe's educated elite due to deep cultural and historical resonances. Greece had been subjugated by the Ottoman Empire since the fifteenth century. As nationalist revolutionary ideas spread across Europe, the Greeks began their struggle for independence in 1821. Nationalists in Greece received massive support from other Greeks living in exile, as well as from Western Europeans who harbored deep sympathies for ancient Greek culture. Renowned poets and artists universally lauded Greece as the absolute 'cradle of European civilisation', framing the conflict as a holy struggle between European culture and an Islamic empire. Figures like the English poet Lord Byron even organized funds and went to fight. This intense romanticization culminated in the 1832 Treaty of Constantinople, proving nationalist struggles could triumph.

Answer any one of the following:
(a) Describe the role of manufacturing industries in the economic development of a country.
OR

sub_questions.text: (a) देश के आर्थिक विकास में विनिर्माण उद्योग की भूमिका का वर्णन कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) Describe the role of manufacturing industries in the economic development of a country.

key_points: Modernizes agriculture and reduces heavy dependence on agricultural income
Creates massive employment opportunities in secondary and tertiary sectors
Helps in the eradication of unemployment and dire poverty
Export of manufactured goods expands trade and brings in valuable foreign exchange
Transforms raw materials into highly valuable finished products, accelerating national wealth

sub_questions.solution: Manufacturing industries act as the backbone of a country's rapid economic development for multiple pivotal reasons. Firstly, they fundamentally modernize agriculture, which forms the base of the economy, by providing modern machinery like tractors and pumps. Secondly, by providing massive employment opportunities in both the secondary and tertiary sectors, manufacturing reduces the severe over-dependence of the population on agricultural income. Thirdly, industrial growth is crucial for the massive eradication of unemployment and extreme poverty from society. Fourthly, manufacturing highly value-added products and exporting them directly expands international trade and commerce, bringing in critically required foreign exchange. Ultimately, countries that successfully transform their raw materials into a diverse array of finished goods achieve unprecedented economic prosperity.

sub_questions.text: (b) औद्योगिक प्रदूषण से स्वच्छ जल को बचाने के लिए उठाए गए किन्हीं पाँच कदमों का वर्णन कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Describe any five steps taken to save fresh water from industrial pollution.

key_points: Minimising water usage by heavily reusing and recycling it in successive stages
Harvesting rainwater to fulfill the massive water requirements of industries
Strictly treating hot water and toxic effluents before discharging them into rivers
Primary treatment by mechanical means (screening, grinding)
Secondary and tertiary treatment by biological, chemical, and physical processes

sub_questions.solution: To effectively safeguard precious fresh water from devastating industrial pollution, several crucial steps must be implemented. Firstly, industries should drastically minimize fresh water usage by systematically reusing and recycling water through two or more successive manufacturing stages. Secondly, rainwater harvesting techniques must be mandatorily adopted to fulfill internal industrial water requirements naturally. Thirdly, it is absolutely essential to mandate the comprehensive treatment of hot water and toxic chemical effluents before they are irresponsibly discharged into rivers and ponds. This treatment occurs in three phases: primary mechanical treatment involving screening and sedimentation; secondary biological treatment; and finally, highly advanced tertiary treatment utilizing chemical and physical processes to recycle wastewater entirely. Furthermore, strict legal regulations must oversee the overdrawing of groundwater reserves by industries.

questions.text_english:
Answer any one of the following:
(a) Analyse the importance of democracy in accommodation of social diversity.
OR
(b) Analyse the importance of democracy in reducing poverty and inequality.

sub_questions.text: (a) सामाजिक विविधता में सामंजस्य के लिए लोकतंत्र के महत्त्व का विश्लेषण कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) Analyse the importance of democracy in accommodation of social diversity.

key_points: Democracies develop systematic procedures to conduct peaceful competition and negotiations
It reduces the explosive possibility of tensions becoming violent
Majority must constantly work with the minority so government functions generally
Rule by majority is not rule by a single religious or linguistic majority community
Provides political equality and a platform for marginalized groups to voice grievances

sub_questions.solution: Democracy is exceptionally important for accommodating deep social diversities because it fosters peaceful coexistence. No society can fully and permanently resolve all conflicts among different groups. However, a democracy develops highly systematic procedures to conduct negotiations and competitions, vastly reducing the possibility of these tensions exploding into violent conflict. Furthermore, democracy teaches the absolute necessity for the majority to constantly work with the minority, ensuring that governments represent the general public view. Crucially, democracy ensures that 'majority rule' does not degenerate into tyrannical rule by a single linguistic or religious community; rather, any citizen can potentially form a majority. Ultimately, by providing fundamental political equality, democracy gives disadvantaged and marginalized groups an empowered platform to legitimately voice their grievances.

sub_questions.text: (b) ग़रीबी और असमानता को कम करने में लोकतंत्र के महत्त्व का विश्लेषण कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Analyse the importance of democracy in reducing poverty and inequality.

key_points: Democracy guarantees fundamental political equality, giving equal voting rights to the poor
Elected governments are forced to address poverty to secure massive vote banks
Provides a framework to implement welfare schemes and redistributive policies
Allows the poor to form groups and protest against economic injustices
However, democracies often fall short in practice regarding extreme economic inequalities

sub_questions.solution: The importance of democracy in reducing poverty and inequality lies in its foundational principle of political equality. In a democracy, every citizen, regardless of their economic status, holds one vote of equal value. Because the poor constitute a massive proportion of the voters, no political party can afford to entirely ignore their plight. Consequently, elected governments are structurally pressured to formulate extensive welfare schemes, subsidies, and redistributive policies aimed specifically at poverty alleviation. Furthermore, democracy grants the poor the vital freedom to unionize, protest, and demand better wages and conditions. However, it must be critically noted that while democracy provides the ideal framework and theoretical tools for economic justice, in reality, democracies have often been quite slow and sometimes unsuccessful in effectively dismantling deeply entrenched economic inequalities.

Answer any one of the following:
(a) There is a need for protection and support of the workers in the unorganised sector. Examine the statement with examples.
OR
(b) Activities in the private sector are guided by the motive to earn profits. Examine the statement with examples.

sub_questions.text: (a) असंगठित क्षेत्रक में श्रमिकों को संरक्षण और सहायता की आवश्यकता है। उदाहरणों सहित इस कथन की परख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) There is a need for protection and support of the workers in the unorganised sector. Examine the statement with examples.

key_points: Wages are extremely low and often irregular
Lack of job security; workers can be dismissed anytime without cause
No formal benefits like paid leave, provident fund, or medical benefits
Working conditions are often hazardous with excessively long hours
Vulnerable social groups (SC/ST) face both economic exploitation and social discrimination

sub_questions.solution: The unorganised sector is highly exploitative, making the massive protection and active support of its workers an absolute necessity. Firstly, workers here endure extremely low and highly irregular wages, keeping them trapped in poverty. For instance, landless agricultural labourers or urban construction workers have no guaranteed minimum wage. Secondly, there is a total lack of job security; employers can terminate workers arbitrarily without any notice. Thirdly, these workers are completely deprived of crucial statutory benefits like paid leave, provident fund, pensions, and medical insurance. Fourthly, their working environments are frequently hazardous, involving excruciatingly long working hours without overtime pay. Furthermore, a massive proportion of these workers belong to marginalized communities (SC/ST/OBC), meaning they suffer severe social discrimination alongside deep economic exploitation, urgently necessitating stringent government intervention and protective laws.

sub_questions.text: (b) निजी क्षेत्रक की गतिविधियों का ध्येय लाभ अर्जित करना होता है। उदाहरणों सहित इस कथन की परख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Activities in the private sector are guided by the motive to earn profits. Examine the statement with examples.

key_points: Ownership and control lie with private individuals or companies seeking returns on investment
Services are provided strictly at a price that yields profit
They do not invest in heavily loss-making but socially essential public goods
Examples like TISCO or Reliance focus on profitable ventures, not free public health or basic education
Government must step in for welfare as private sector ignores non-profitable societal needs

sub_questions.solution: The fundamental characteristic of the private sector is that ownership of assets and the delivery of all services rest securely in the hands of private individuals or corporate entities. Consequently, their primary, overriding motive is to maximize financial profits for owners and shareholders. To avail themselves of the services manufactured by these entities, consumers must pay a premium price. For example, prominent companies like Tata Iron and Steel Company (TISCO) or Reliance Industries operate strictly on calculated commercial viability. Because their sole goal is profit, the private sector deliberately avoids investing in massive, socially essential projects that yield zero returns or require huge capital with long gestation periods, such as building extensive public roads, providing free primary education, or establishing affordable rural healthcare. They only produce goods that affluent markets can afford, requiring the government to intervene for actual public welfare.

दिए गए स्रोत को पढ़िए और उसके नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
1857 के विद्रोह के बाद प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता के प्रति रवैया बदल गया । क्रुद्ध अंग्रेज़ों ने 'देसी' प्रेस का मुँह बंद करने की माँग की। ज्यों-ज्यों भाषाई समाचार-पत्र राष्ट्रवाद से समर्थन में मुखर होते गए, त्यों-त्यों औपनिवेशिक सरकार में कड़े नियंत्रण के प्रस्ताव पर बहस तेज़ होने लगी । आइरिश प्रेस कानून के तर्ज पर 1878 में वर्नाक्यूलर प्रेस ऐक्ट लागू कर दिया गया । इससे सरकार को भाषाई प्रेस में छपी रपट और संपादकीय को सेंसर करने का व्यापक हक़ मिल गया । अब से सरकार ने विभिन्न प्रदेशों से छपने वाले भाषाई अख़बारों पर नियमित नज़र रखनी शुरू कर दी। अगर किसी रपट को बाग़ी करार दिया जाता था तो अख़बार को पहले चेतावनी दी जाती थी, और अगर चेतावनी की अनसुनी हुई तो अख़बार को ज़ब्त किया जा सकता था और छपाई की मशीनें छीन ली जा सकती थीं ।
questions.text_english:
Read the given source and answer the questions that follow :
After the Revolt of 1857, the attitude to freedom of the press changed. Enraged Englishmen demanded a clamp down on the 'native' press. As vernacular newspapers became assertively nationalist, the colonial government began debating measures of stringent control. In 1878, the Vernacular Press Act was passed, modelled on the Irish Press Laws. It provided the government with extensive rights to censor reports and editorials in the vernacular press. From now on the government kept regular track of the vernacular newspapers published in different provinces. When a report was judged as seditious, the newspaper was warned, and if the warning was ignored, the press was liable to be seized and the printing machinery confiscated.

sub_questions.text_english: (34.1) On which rule was the 'Vernacular Press Act' based?

key_points: Modelled on the Irish Press Laws

sub_questions.solution: According to the provided passage, the Vernacular Press Act passed in 1878 was directly modelled on the Irish Press Laws.

sub_questions.text: (34.2) 1857 के विद्रोह के बाद प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता के प्रति अंग्रेज़ों का रवैया क्यों बदल गया ? स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (34.2) Why did the attitude of the British change towards the freedom of press after the Revolt of 1857? Explain.

key_points: Enraged Englishmen demanded a clamp down
Vernacular newspapers were becoming assertively nationalist and anti-colonial

sub_questions.solution: The attitude changed drastically because enraged Englishmen felt threatened by the uprising and demanded a severe clampdown. They realized that the rapidly growing 'native' or vernacular newspapers were becoming dangerously and assertively nationalist, stirring up anti-colonial sentiments.

sub_questions.text: (34.3) 'वर्नाक्यूलर प्रेस ऐक्ट' लागू होने के किन्हीं दो प्रभावों की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (34.3) Explain any two impacts of passing the 'Vernacular Press Act.'

key_points: Government acquired extensive rights to censor reports and editorials in the vernacular press
Press machinery could be confiscated if warnings regarding 'seditious' reports were ignored

sub_questions.solution: Passing the Vernacular Press Act had immediate and severe impacts. First, the colonial government acquired sweeping and extensive legal rights to ruthlessly censor reports and editorials published in local languages. Second, it created a system of strict surveillance and intimidation; if a newspaper published a seditious report and ignored a warning, the government could physically seize the press and completely confiscate their printing machinery.

संसाधनों का संरक्षण : संसाधन किसी भी तरह के विकास में महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाते हैं । परंतु संसाधनों का विवेकहीन उपभोग और अति-उपयोग के कारण कई सामाजिक-आर्थिक और पर्यावरणीय समस्याएँ पैदा हो सकती हैं। इन समस्याओं से बचाव के लिए विभिन्न स्तरों पर संसाधनों का संरक्षण आवश्यक है । भूतकाल से ही संसाधनों का संरक्षण बहुत से नेताओं और चिंतकों के लिए चिंता का विषय रहा है। उदाहरणार्थ, गाँधीजी ने संसाधनों के संरक्षण पर अपनी चिंता इन शब्दों में व्यक्त की है- हमारे पास हर व्यक्ति की आवश्यकता पूर्ति के लिए बहुत कुछ है, लेकिन किसी के लालच की संतुष्टि के लिए नहीं । अर्थात् हमारे पास पेट भरने के लिए बहुत है, लेकिन पेटी भरने के लिए नहीं । उनके अनुसार विश्व स्तर पर संसाधन हास के लिए लालची और स्वार्थी व्यक्ति तथा आधुनिक प्रौद्योगिकी की शोषणात्मक प्रवृत्ति जिम्मेदार है । वे अत्यधिक उत्पादन के विरुद्ध थे और इसके स्थान पर अधिक बड़े जनसमुदाय द्वारा उत्पादन के पक्षधर थे ।

Conservation of Resources: Resources are vital for any developmental activity. But irrational consumption and over-utilisation of resources may lead to socio-economic and environmental problems. To overcome these problems, resource conservation at various levels is important. This had been the main concern of the leaders and thinkers in the past. For example, Gandhiji was very apt in voicing his concern about resource conservation in these words: There is enough for everybody's need and not for any body's greed. He placed the greedy and selfish individuals and exploitative nature of modern technology as the root cause for resource depletion at the global level. He was against mass production and wanted to replace it with the production by the masses.

sub_questions.text: (35.1) 'संसाधन नियोजन' को परिभाषित कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (35.1) Define the term 'Resource Planning'.

key_points: Judicious and planned use of resources

sub_questions.solution: Resource planning refers to the widely accepted strategy for the highly judicious, rational, and sustainable use of available resources.

sub_questions.text: (35.2) संसाधनों के संरक्षण की आवश्यकता को स्पष्ट कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (35.2) Explain the need for conservation of resources.

key_points: To prevent severe socio-economic and environmental problems caused by irrational consumption

sub_questions.solution: Conservation is absolutely crucial because the irrational consumption and rampant over-utilisation of resources directly lead to severe, irreversible socio-economic and massive environmental problems.

sub_questions.text: (35.3) गाँधीजी ने क्यों कहा कि – 'हमारे पास हर व्यक्ति की आवश्यकता पूर्ति के लिए बहुत कुछ है, लेकिन किसी के लालच की संतुष्टि के लिए नहीं' ? किन्हीं दो कारणों का विश्लेषण कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (35.3) Why did Gandhiji say There is enough for everybody's need and not for any body's greed? Analyse any two reasons.

key_points: He believed greedy and selfish individuals cause rapid resource depletion globally
He saw the exploitative nature of modern technology as a destroyer of resources

sub_questions.solution: Gandhiji made this statement to attack capitalist exploitation. Firstly, he fundamentally identified that the reckless greed and extreme selfishness of certain individuals were the absolute root cause of rapid resource depletion at the global level. Secondly, he strongly opposed the highly exploitative nature of modern machine technology, which promoted massive 'mass production' that inherently destroyed resources faster than nature could replenish them, leading to enormous inequality.

बैंकों के अलावा ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में सस्ते ऋण का एक अन्य स्रोत सहकारी समितियाँ हैं । सहकारी समिति के सदस्य अपने संसाधनों को कुछ क्षेत्रों में सहयोग के लिए एकत्र करते हैं । कई प्रकार की सहकारी समितियाँ संभव हैं, जैसे- किसानों, बुनकरों एवं औद्योगिक मज़दूरों इत्यादि की सहकारी समितियाँ । कृषक सहकारी समिति सोनपुर के नज़दीक एक गाँव में काम करती है । इसके 2300 किसान सदस्य हैं । यह अपने सदस्यों से जमा प्राप्त करती हैं। इस जमा पूँजी को ऋणाधार मानते हुए, इस सहकारी समिति ने बैंक से बड़ा ऋण प्राप्त किया है। इस पूँजी का इस्तेमाल सदस्यों को कर्ज़ देने के लिए किया जाता है। यह ऋण लौटाने के बाद कर्ज़ का दूसरा दौर शुरू किया जा सकता है ।
कृषक सहकारी समिति कृषि उपकरण खरीदने, खेती तथा कृषि व्यापार करने, मछली पकड़ने, घर बनाने और अन्य विभिन्न प्रकार के ख़र्चों के लिए ऋण मुहैया कराती है ।

Loans from Cooperatives
Besides banks, the other major source of cheap credit in rural areas are the cooperative societies (or cooperatives). Members of a cooperative pool their resources for cooperation in certain areas. There are several types of cooperatives possible such as farmers cooperatives, weavers cooperatives and industrial workers cooperatives, etc. Krishak Cooperative functions in a village not very far away from Sonpur. It has 2300 farmers as members. It accepts deposits from its members. With these deposits as collateral, the Cooperative has obtained a large loan from the bank. These funds are used to provide loans to members. Once these loans are repaid, another round of lending can take place.
Krishak Cooperative provides loans for the purchase of agricultural implements, loans for cultivation and agricultural trade, fishery loans, loans for construction of houses and for a variety of other expenses.

sub_questions.text: (36.2) ग्रामीण विकास में सहकारी समितियों के योगदान की व्याख्या कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (36.2) Explain the contribution of Cooperative Societies in rural development.

key_points: Provides cheap and affordable credit for agriculture and businesses, saving rural people from moneylenders

sub_questions.solution: Cooperative societies profoundly contribute to rural development by successfully pooling local resources to provide highly affordable, cheap credit for essential activities like buying agricultural implements, farming, and constructing houses, thereby saving poor villagers from the vicious trap of exploitative informal moneylenders.

sub_questions.text: (36.3) स्वयं-सहायता समूहों की पूँजी के किन्हीं दो स्रोतों का उल्लेख कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (36.3) Mention any two sources of capital for Self-Help Groups.

key_points: Regular savings deposited by the group members
Loans acquired formally from banks once the group proves its financial discipline

sub_questions.solution: Self-Help Groups (SHGs) systematically build their capital primarily through two key sources. The first fundamental source is the small but consistent, regular monetary savings actively pooled by the group members themselves from their daily wages. Secondly, once an SHG establishes a solid, proven track record of disciplined financial saving and internal repayment over a year or two, it becomes fully eligible to acquire larger, formal loans directly from commercial banks to further expand their capital and activities.
